subject: Hey {{first_name}}, got a quick ask
preview_text: If this app helped you, here's one thing you can do that matters more than anything.
body_paragraphs: {{first_name}}, you've been through the full onboarding series with Thesis Generator, so you know what it can do. You've used it to get unstuck on your {{topic}} {{work_type}}, and maybe even finished something you were proud of. That's exactly why I'm writing to you today.

If this tool has been useful to you, the single best thing you can do is tell one friend who's also stuck on a paper. Not because we're offering a reward—there isn't one—but because you know firsthand how much easier it is when something just works. Your recommendation is the most honest help a peer can get.

Think about someone in your class or dorm who's been staring at a blank page, wasting hours on the same first paragraph. You can save them that time with a quick share. It's a low-cost favor that might make their week, and once you do, you'll probably feel even more motivated to keep using the app yourself.
So here's the ask: forward this email or send them the app link. That's it. No strings, no points, just helping someone who needs it as much as you did.
P.S. If you have a story about how Thesis Generator helped you with your {{topic}}, I'd love to hear it—reply to this email anytime.
cta_text: Share Thesis Generator with a friend
